original_text: It was shown in~\cite{poudel2022feature} that XCT segmentation quality strongly affects defect detectability and size estimation in laser powder bed fusion parts.
injected_text: It was shown in~\cite{poudel2022feature} that XCT segmentation quality strongly affects defect detectability and size estimation in additive manufacturing parts.
rationale: The cited study explicitly bounded its finding to 'laser powder bed fusion parts'; replacing this with 'additive manufacturing parts' over-generalises the claim to all AM processes, which the study did not test.
ground_truth_description: Over-generalised the scope of the cited claim by changing its condition from specifically 'laser powder bed fusion parts' to all 'additive manufacturing parts'.
